listingDetail.goodToKnow.title: Good to know
listingDetail.goodToKnow.compareAll: We compare every channel this home is listed on, so you always see the lowest price.
listingDetail.goodToKnow.messageFirst: Message the host before booking if you have questions about the space or the dates.
listingDetail.goodToKnow.realTime: Prices are fetched live at the moment you compare — they can change between visits.
listingDetail.goodToKnow.directTradeoff: Booking direct can skip platform fees, but you give up that platform's protections.
listingDetail.goodToKnow.protection: Booking through a major channel usually includes payment protection and support.
listingDetail.goodToKnow.flexible: Flexible dates? Try shifting a night or two — availability and price can change a lot.
listingDetail.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
listingDetail.faq.howCompare.a: We look up this exact home on each booking channel it's listed on and fetch a live quote for your dates, then show you the cheapest.
listingDetail.faq.livePrices.a: Channel prices update constantly with demand and availability. We always fetch a fresh quote, so the number you see is current.
listingDetail.faq.bookDirect.a: Some hosts also take bookings on their own site. That can be cheaper, but it's outside the major platforms' protection programs.
listingDetail.faq.protected.a: When you book through a major channel, that platform's payment protection and support apply. We link you straight to it.
listingDetail.faq.fees.q: Are there any fees from you?
listingDetail.faq.fees.a: No. We don't add fees or markups — we send you to the channel to complete your booking at its price.
listingDetail.faq.cancel.a: Cancellation terms are set by the host and the channel you book through. Check them on the channel's page before you pay.
listingDetail.faq.contactHost.q: Can I ask the host a question first?
listingDetail.faq.contactHost.a: Yes — use Contact host to send a message. Many hosts reply within a few hours.
listingDetail.faq.priceDrop.q: Can I be told if the price drops?
listingDetail.faq.priceDrop.a: Use Watch price to get an email if the nightly price for this home falls.
